2.yusuf_ali: It is He Who has taught the Qur'an.
2.mohsin_khan: Has taught (you mankind) the Quran (by His Mercy).

4.yusuf_ali: He has taught him speech (and intelligence).
4.shakir: Taught him the mode of expression.
4.muhammad_sarwar: and has taught him intelligible speech.
4.arberry: and He has taught him the Explanation.

5.sahih_international: The sun and the moon [move] by precise calculation,
5.pickthall: The sun and the moon are made punctual.
5.yusuf_ali: The sun and the moon follow courses (exactly) computed;
5.shakir: The sun and the moon follow a reckoning.
5.muhammad_sarwar: The sun and moon rotate in a predestined orbit.
5.mohsin_khan: The sun and the moon run on their fixed courses (exactly) calculated with measured out stages for each (for reckoning, etc.).
5.arberry: The sun and the moon to a reckoning,

6.sahih_international: And the stars and trees prostrate.
6.pickthall: The stars and the trees prostrate.
6.yusuf_ali: And the herbs and the trees - both (alike) prostrate in adoration.
6.shakir: And the herbs and the trees do prostrate (to Him).
6.muhammad_sarwar: The plants and trees prostrate before Him.
6.mohsin_khan: And the herbs (or stars) and the trees both prostrate.
6.arberry: and the stars and the trees bow themselves;

7.sahih_international: And the heaven He raised and imposed the balance
7.pickthall: And the sky He hath uplifted; and He hath set the measure,
7.yusuf_ali: And the Firmament has He raised high, and He has set up the Balance (of Justice),
7.shakir: And the heaven, He raised it high, and He made the balance
7.muhammad_sarwar: He raised the heavens and set up everything in balance,
7.mohsin_khan: And the heaven He has raised high, and He has set up the Balance.
7.arberry: and heaven -- He raised it up, and set the Balance.

8.sahih_international: That you not transgress within the balance.
8.pickthall: That ye exceed not the measure,
8.yusuf_ali: In order that ye may not transgress (due) balance.
8.shakir: That you may not be inordinate in respect of the measure.
8.muhammad_sarwar: so that you would maintain justice.
8.mohsin_khan: In order that you may not transgress (due) balance.

9.sahih_international: And establish weight in justice and do not make deficient the balance.
9.pickthall: But observe the measure strictly, nor fall short thereof.
9.yusuf_ali: So establish weight with justice and fall not short in the balance.
9.shakir: And keep up the balance with equity and do not make the measure deficient.
9.muhammad_sarwar: Therefore, maintain just measure and do not transgress against the Balance.
9.mohsin_khan: And observe the weight with equity and do not make the balance deficient.
9.arberry: and weigh with justice, and skimp not in the Balance.)

10.sahih_international: And the earth He laid [out] for the creatures.
10.pickthall: And the earth hath He appointed for (His) creatures,
10.yusuf_ali: It is He Who has spread out the earth for (His) creatures:
10.shakir: And the earth, He has set it for living creatures;
10.muhammad_sarwar: He spread out the earth for the people.
10.mohsin_khan: And the earth He has put for the creatures.
10.arberry: And earth -- He set it down for all beings,

11.sahih_international: Therein is fruit and palm trees having sheaths [of dates]
11.pickthall: Wherein are fruit and sheathed palm-trees,
11.yusuf_ali: Therein is fruit and date-palms, producing spathes (enclosing dates);
11.shakir: Therein is fruit and palms having sheathed clusters,
11.muhammad_sarwar: There exists all kinds of fruits, palm-trees with sheathed blossoms,
11.mohsin_khan: Therein are fruits, date-palms producing sheathed fruit-stalks (enclosing dates).
11.arberry: therein fruits, and palm-trees with sheaths,

12.sahih_international: And grain having husks and scented plants.
12.yusuf_ali: Also corn, with (its) leaves and stalk for fodder, and sweet-smelling plants.
12.shakir: And the grain with (its) husk and fragrance.
12.muhammad_sarwar: grain with its husk and aromatic herbs.
12.mohsin_khan: And also corn, with (its) leaves and stalk for fodder, and sweet-scented plants.
12.arberry: and grain in the blade, and fragrant herbs.

14.mohsin_khan: He created man (Adam) from sounding clay like the clay of pottery.
14.arberry: He created man of a clay like the potter's,

15.arberry: and He created the jinn of a smokeless fire.

17.mohsin_khan: (He is) the Lord of the two easts (places of sunrise during early summer and early winter) and the Lord of the two wests (places of sunset during early summer and early winter).
17.arberry: Lord of the Two Easts, Lord of the Two Wests,

19.pickthall: He hath loosed the two seas. They meet.
19.yusuf_ali: He has let free the two bodies of flowing water, meeting together:
19.shakir: He has made the two seas to flow freely (so that) they meet together:

19.mohsin_khan: He has let loosed the two seas (the salt water and the sweet) meeting together.

20.muhammad_sarwar: but has created a barrier between them so that they will not merge totally.
20.mohsin_khan: Between them is a barrier which none of them can transgress.
20.arberry: between them a barrier they do not overpass.

21.sahih_international: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
21.pickthall: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?

21.shakir: Which then of the bounties of your Lord will you deny?

21.mohsin_khan: Then which of the Blessings of your Lord will you both (jinns and men) deny?
21.arberry: O which of your Lord's bounties will you and you deny?

22.sahih_international: From both of them emerge pearl and coral.
22.pickthall: There cometh forth from both of them the pearl and coral-stone.
22.yusuf_ali: Out of them come Pearls and Coral:
22.shakir: There come forth from them pearls, both large and small.
22.muhammad_sarwar: From the two oceans comes pearls and coral.
22.mohsin_khan: Out of them both come out pearl and coral.
22.arberry: From them come forth the pearl and the coral.

24.pickthall: His are the ships displayed upon the sea, like banners.
24.yusuf_ali: And His are the Ships sailing smoothly through the seas, lofty as mountains:

26.mohsin_khan: Whatsoever is on it (the earth) will perish.

29.sahih_international: Whoever is within the heavens and earth asks Him; every day He is bringing about a matter.
29.pickthall: All that are in the heavens and the earth entreat Him. Every day He exerciseth (universal) power.
29.yusuf_ali: Of Him seeks (its need) every creature in the heavens and on earth: every day in (new) Splendour doth He (shine)!
29.shakir: All those who are in the heavens and the earth ask of Him; every moment He is in a state (of glory).
29.muhammad_sarwar: Everyone in the heavens and the earth depends on Him. His task in preserving His creation is continuous.
29.mohsin_khan: Whosoever is in the heavens and on earth begs of Him (its needs from Him). Every day He has a matter to bring forth (such as giving honour to some, disgrace to some, life to some, death to some, etc.)!
29.arberry: Whatsoever is in the heavens and the earth implore Him; every day He is upon some labour.

31.sahih_international: We will attend to you, O prominent beings.
31.pickthall: We shall dispose of you, O ye two dependents (man and jinn).
31.yusuf_ali: Soon shall We settle your affairs, O both ye worlds!
31.shakir: Soon will We apply Ourselves to you, O you two armies.
31.muhammad_sarwar: Jinn and mankind, We shall certainly settle your accounts.
31.mohsin_khan: We shall attend to you, O you two classes (jinns and men)!
31.arberry: We shall surely attend to you at leisure, you weight and you weight!

33.sahih_international: O company of jinn and mankind, if you are able to pass beyond the regions of the heavens and the earth, then pass. You will not pass except by authority [from Allah].
33.pickthall: O company of jinn and men, if ye have power to penetrate (all) regions of the heavens and the earth, then penetrate (them)! Ye will never penetrate them save with (Our) sanction.
33.yusuf_ali: O ye assembly of Jinns and men! If it be ye can pass beyond the zones of the heavens and the earth, pass ye! not without authority shall ye be able to pass!
33.shakir: O assembly of the jinn and the men! If you are able to pass through the regions of the heavens and the earth, then pass through; you cannot pass through but with authority.
33.muhammad_sarwar: Jinn and mankind, if you can penetrate the diameters of the heavens and the earth, do so, but you cannot do so without power and authority.
33.mohsin_khan: O assembly of jinns and men! If you have power to pass beyond the zones of the heavens and the earth, then pass (them)! But you will never be able to pass them, except with authority (from Allah)!
33.arberry: O tribe of jinn and of men, if you are able to pass through the confines of heaven and earth, pass through them! You shall not pass through except with an authority.

34.sahih_international: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

34.arberry: O which of your Lord's bounties will you and you deny?

35.pickthall: There will be sent, against you both, heat of fire and flash of brass, and ye will not escape.
35.yusuf_ali: On you will be sent (O ye evil ones twain!) a flame of fire (to burn) and a smoke (to choke): no defence will ye have:
35.shakir: The flames of fire and smoke will be sent on you two, then you will not be able to defend yourselves.
35.muhammad_sarwar: Flames of fire and molten brass will be released against you and you will not be able to protect yourselves.
35.mohsin_khan: There will be sent against you both, smokeless flames of fire and (molten) brass, and you will not be able to defend yourselves.
35.arberry: Against you shall be loosed a flame of fire, and molten brass; and you shall not be helped.
